notes: Reworded clinical and scolding labels into plain, encouraging language across the app - the muscle-balance card now reads 'room to grow', 'sweet spot' and 'not trained yet' instead of 'below MEV' and 'untrained', and no score band is called 'No good'.
Three in a Row is now Three on Target: it rewards meeting your weekly session target in three weeks, not three days in a row - the last consecutive-day reward, in badges and in XP, is gone.
Celebrations now fire only after you save a session, and everything earned in one save arrives as a single celebration you dismiss in one tap.
